clinician.final_diagnosis: gastric artery injury resulting from blunt abdominal trauma
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 66-year-old woman presented with upper abdominal pain and shock after a vehicle collision. Initial CT revealed rib fractures, liver and splenic injuries, intra-abdominal hemorrhage, and extravascular leakage of contrast medium, highly suspicious for right gastric artery involvement. After hemodynamic stabilization, a review of the CT confirmed the right gastric artery injury. Angiography showed irregularities in the vessel, and coil embolization was performed, which was confirmed as complete. Post-embolization, the patient's cardiopulmonary status was stable, though she experienced transient coagulopathy requiring fresh frozen plasma. Follow-up CTs confirmed resolution of extravascular leakage, reduction in hematoma, and absence of rebleeding or pseudoaneurysm. The patient was transferred and resumed daily activities without sequelae.

key_supporting_evidence.claim: Patient presented with upper abdominal pain and shock after a vehicle collision.
Initial CT showed left 4th-8th rib fractures, liver injury (Grade IIIa JAT/II AAST), and splenic injury (Grade IIIa JAT/II AAST).
Initial CT showed suspected right gastric artery involvement as the source of bleeding, substantiated by intra-abdominal hemorrhage and extravascular leakage of contrast medium.
A review of the contrast-enhanced CT confirmed the presence of a right gastric artery injury, prompting the decision to perform arterial embolization.
Angiography revealed irregularities in the diameter of the right gastric artery, and coil embolization was performed due to vessel irregularities and potential for rebleeding/pseudoaneurysm.
Subsequent angiography confirmed the complete embolization of the afflicted vessel.

Post-embolization, the patient's cardiopulmonary status remained stable, and follow-up CTs confirmed resolution of extravascular contrast leakage, absence of pseudoaneurysms, and reduction in hematoma.
The patient resumed her daily activities without any sequelae.
